FileMoa RAW decoder: libraw-wasm-nothread 1.6.0-nothread.1
Runtime JS/WASM: unmodified, verified against npm and pinned upstream commit.
Wrapper: ISC, ybouane and contributors; Oscar Gallego Ruiz (fork).
LibRaw 0.22.1: CDDL 1.0, LibRaw LLC and contributors. CDDL applies to LibRaw
and its covered modifications, not automatically to FileMoa's separate code.
Little CMS 2.19.1: MIT, Marti Maria and contributors.
IJG JPEG 9f, libpng 1.6.58, zlib 1.3.2, Emscripten 6.0.10 and runtime
licenses/notices are supplied alongside this file and in source-bundle.zip.
LibRaw subcomponent notices are preserved in the full source archive.
Download corresponding sources: ./source-bundle.zip (free, no registration).
Build/source details: ./BUILDING.txt. Integrity/versions: ./manifest.json.

Photos stay on the user's device. This library performs no photo upload.
